```{r data}
followup_source_path <- "/Users/fuminli/Desktop/CARDIAC-FM/supplementary_tables_final.xlsx"

row_order <- c(
  "UKB | AF",
  "UKB | HF",
  "CHS | AF",
  "CHS | HF",
  "MESA | AF",
  "MESA | HF"
)

parse_count_rate <- function(x) {
  parsed <- str_match(as.character(x), "^([0-9,]+)\\(([-0-9.]+)\\)$")
  tibble(
    n = as.numeric(str_remove_all(parsed[, 2], ",")),
    rate = as.numeric(parsed[, 3])
  )
}

extract_outcome <- function(sheet, cohort, outcome_label, outcome_abbr) {
  sheet_data <- read_excel(followup_source_path, sheet = sheet, col_names = FALSE)
  outcome_row <- which(sheet_data$...1 == outcome_label)
  outcome_data <- sheet_data[(outcome_row + 1):(outcome_row + 3), ]
  followup_time_value <- sheet_data %>%
    filter(`...1` == "Follow-up time, median(Q1, Q3), year") %>%
    pull(`...2`) %>%
    as.character() %>%
    str_squish() %>%
    str_replace_all(",\\s*", ", ")

  baseline_positive <- parse_count_rate(outcome_data$...2[1])
  baseline_total <- outcome_data$...2 %>%
    parse_count_rate() %>%
    pull(n) %>%
    head(2) %>%
    sum(na.rm = TRUE)
  baseline_event_rate <- 100 * baseline_positive$n / baseline_total

  followup_positive <- parse_count_rate(outcome_data$...3[1])
  followup_total <- outcome_data$...3 %>%
    parse_count_rate() %>%
    pull(n) %>%
    head(2) %>%
    sum(na.rm = TRUE)
  followup_event_rate <- 100 * followup_positive$n / followup_total

  tibble(
    cohort = cohort,
    outcome = outcome_abbr,
    row_label = paste(cohort, outcome_abbr, sep = " | "),
    baseline_label = sprintf(
      "N=%s\nEvents=%s (%.1f%%)",
      comma(baseline_total),
      comma(baseline_positive$n),
      baseline_event_rate
    ),
    baseline_rate = baseline_event_rate,
    followup_cohort_label = if_else(
      is.na(followup_positive$n),
      "-",
      sprintf(
        "N=%s\nEvents=%s (%.1f%%)",
        comma(followup_total),
        comma(followup_positive$n),
        followup_event_rate
      )
    ),
    followup_rate = followup_event_rate,
    followup_time_label = followup_time_value
  )
}

summary_data <- bind_rows(
  extract_outcome("Table2", "UKB", "5-year Incident Atrial Fibrillation, N (%)", "AF"),
  extract_outcome("Table2", "UKB", "5-year Incident Heart Failure, N (%)", "HF"),
  extract_outcome("Table3", "CHS", "5-year Incident Atrial Fibrillation, N (%)", "AF"),
  extract_outcome("Table3", "CHS", "5-year Incident Heart Failure, N (%)", "HF"),
  extract_outcome("Table4", "MESA", "5-year Incident Atrial Fibrillation, N (%)", "AF"),
  extract_outcome("Table4", "MESA", "5-year Incident Heart Failure, N (%)", "HF")
) %>%
  mutate(row_label = factor(row_label, levels = rev(row_order)))

plot_grid <- summary_data %>%
  select(row_label, baseline_label, baseline_rate, followup_cohort_label, followup_rate) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(baseline_label, followup_cohort_label),
    names_to = "cohort_period",
    values_to = "cell_label"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    positive_rate = if_else(cohort_period == "baseline_label", baseline_rate, followup_rate),
    cohort_period = recode(
      cohort_period,
      "baseline_label" = "Baseline cohort",
      "followup_cohort_label" = "Follow-up cohort"
    ),
    cohort_period = factor(cohort_period, levels = c("Baseline cohort", "Follow-up cohort")),
    row_label = factor(row_label, levels = rev(row_order)),
    y = recode(
      as.character(row_label),
      "UKB | AF" = 6,
      "UKB | HF" = 5,
      "CHS | AF" = 4,
      "CHS | HF" = 3,
      "MESA | AF" = 2,
      "MESA | HF" = 1
    ),
    fill_rate = positive_rate
  )

followup_data <- summary_data %>%
  distinct(cohort, followup_time_label) %>%
  mutate(
    y = recode(cohort, "UKB" = 5.5, "CHS" = 3.5, "MESA" = 1.5),
    x = "Follow-up time\nmedian (Q1, Q3), years"
  )
```

```{r figure, fig.width=9.6, fig.height=5.1, dpi=300}
base_family <- "Helvetica"

p_cells <- ggplot(plot_grid, aes(x = cohort_period, y = y)) +
  geom_tile(
    data = filter(plot_grid, is.na(fill_rate)),
    fill = "#F2F3F0",
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.9,
    width = 0.98,
    height = 0.90
  ) +
  geom_tile(
    data = filter(plot_grid, !is.na(fill_rate)),
    aes(fill = fill_rate),
    color = "white",
    linewidth = 0.9,
    width = 0.98,
    height = 0.90
  ) +
  geom_text(
    aes(label = cell_label, color = is.na(fill_rate)),
    lineheight = 0.95,
    size = 3.2,
    family = base_family
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colours = c("#E8F3F1", "#F4D9BD", "#C65A46"),
    values = rescale(c(2, 7, 14.5)),
    limits = c(2, 14.5),
    oob = squish,
    breaks = c(5, 10),
    labels = label_percent(scale = 1, accuracy = 1),
    name = "Positive rate"
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "#172026", "TRUE" = "#777A7D"), guide = "none") +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Baseline cohort", "Follow-up cohort"), position = "top") +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0.5, 6.5),
    breaks = 6:1,
    labels = row_order,
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = base_family, base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#172026", size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "#172026", size = 10, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.justification = "center",
    legend.box.margin = margin(t = 8),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 0, 8, 8)
  )

p_followup <- ggplot(followup_data, aes(x = "Median follow-up\n(Q1-Q3), years", y = y)) +
  geom_tile(fill = "#263746", color = "white", linewidth = 0.9, width = 0.98, height = 1.88) +
  geom_text(aes(label = followup_time_label), color = "white", lineheight = 0.92, size = 3.2, family = base_family) +
  scale_x_discrete(position = "top") +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 6.5), breaks = 1:6, labels = NULL, expand = c(0, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_family = base_family, base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#172026", size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = margin(65, 8, 36, 4)
  )

summary_plot <- p_cells + p_followup + plot_layout(widths = c(2.6, 1.05), guides = "keep")

summary_plot

```
